system.description:
A Scalding creature suffers the effects of their body and physical form being unable to function to its full potential.

A Scalded creature reduces damage they deal by -2, for each rank they have.

A creature with 3 or more ranks of Scald loses all Temporary Hit Points they have, and cannot gain more.

A creature with 5 ranks of Scald cannot cast jutsu with the Barrier keyword.

Creatures that are immune to Acid damage is immune to this condition.

A Scalded creature can spend an Action to make a DC 20 Constitution ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends.
system.summary: −2 damage dealt per rank; no temporary HP at 3 ranks; no Barrier jutsu at 5; DC 20 Constitution to end.

rules.text: At 3 or more ranks it loses its temporary HP and can't gain more; at 5 ranks it can't cast Barrier jutsu.
